description: To send password-recovery codes, the app uses your own e-mail account. This app has no server, so nothing is sent to a third-party service.

error.auth: The mail server rejected your username or password. Gmail requires an App Password, not your main password.
error.connection: Could not reach the mail server; check the host, port and your internet connection
error.invalid_recipient: The recipient address is not valid

gmail_hint: Gmail needs an App Password, not your normal password: turn on 2-step verification in your Google security settings, then create a 16-character password under App Passwords.
not_configured_hint: Until this section is filled in, recovery codes are shown inside the app instead of being e-mailed.
test_ok: Connected to the mail server successfully
title: E-mail
